# memo's `sources` answers

Captured 2026-11-08 from cli-memo PR #711 (`feat(sources)`) built on cli-core 0.616.0, run on a throwaway store with
made-up people (`MESSAGING_STORE` in a temp folder, `DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS=disabled:`). `run_id` and
`duration_ms` were removed. `url-refused.json`, `no-text.json` and `unsupported.json` are what memo printed on stderr
with exit code 2.
